alt: 5명의 철학자가 이웃한 젓가락 두 개를 공유하는 식사 문제
prompt: Create ONE original raster PNG technical educational diagram for a Korean IT blog. White opaque background, navy readable sans-serif text, flat blue/teal boxes, generous whitespace. Use only the exact subject and components below. No logos, watermark, decorative illustrations, unrelated graphs, extra numeric values or invented facts. Redesign composition rather than copy source. Every connection must be accurate and labels fully readable.  Title Dining philosophers. A round table with central shared bowl RICE. Around circumference exactly FIVE philosopher node circles P0,P1,P2,P3,P4 clockwise. Exactly FIVE single chopsticks C0..C4 between adjacent philosopher nodes: C0 between P0/P1, C1 between P1/P2, C2 between P2/P3, C3 between P3/P4, C4 between P4/P0. No extra cutlery. Small footer Each philosopher needs both adjacent chopsticks to eat. Show static resource sharing, not promise deadlock-free.
